replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Yes, anyone can build.
Guideline:
- Build the map on single player mode, or on a server. Worldedit or Voxelsniper would be helpful when creating maps for the use of terrain, copy and pasting and more features.
- After you finished building. Get a download link for the build using mediafire, dropbox or other download websites.
- Get a YML for your build, using pastebin.
- Make a forum topic under the section "Map Releases" and provide the Map name, creators name, which gamemode, download link, YML and screenshots of the build.

If you have any further questions or regards, you can check out:
http://avicus.net/forums/c55047443
http://avicus.net/forums/b3980ce7d

Hope this helped :D
